items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 220:1
items.html: In every place where the concluding Malchut ascends, from there and downward an empty void is made, empty of all light, for she concludes the upper light and holds it back from shining from her and downward. (Part 1, Page 888, Sub Header, "and he raised").
